## 66fcab92de52

**Reproduced teaching ambiguity under arbitrary query rotation; ordered
production may still be intentional.** The required-rotation semantic gate
materialized 12 lessons and checked 60 query positions. Production lessons were
otherwise valid, all 600 sampled inputs passed strict validation, all four
corner witnesses fired, and declared rivals were executable. However, 9/60
rotations were ambiguous with 9 hook warnings and zero scoring errors.

The concrete survivor is the generator's own declared `skip_top_right` rival.
When the sole top-right case becomes the held-out query, the remaining four
demonstrations contain no top-right input, so that rival fits every demo and
changes the query. One retained example is easy band seed `73709385710049`,
sample index `0`, query position `1`, with train positions `[0,2,3,4]`.

Evidence:
`checks/audit/66fcab92de52/semantic/checks/66fcab92de52_after_semantic_gate.json`
and its log. The audited generator SHA-256 is
`4fe8d38c81c1c369c7e184f09dd67786be20d8860206544b1848d718dc942674`.
This is a training defect only if downstream assembly permits arbitrary query
rotation; for a fixed ordered curriculum it is a documented domain limitation.
No audit-target source was changed.
